frontier_papers.title: Scaling Compute-Optimal Test-Time Verification in Speculative Agent Trees

frontier_papers.title: Sub-2-Bit Ternary Quantization and Continuous Latent Anchoring for Generative Media

frontier_papers.title: Hybrid HPC-to-Edge Knowledge Distillation over High-Throughput SLURM Clusters

payload.synthesized_gap: Existing work from DeepMind, Anthropic, and FAIR leaves an open gap in 'Speculative GraphRAG Distillation & Sub-4-Bit Edge Verification': bridging campus-scale GPU distillation (FAU Research Computing) with 24/7 homelab GraphRAG silos and sub-4-bit on-device edge verification.

agents.theorist: Formulates coupled loss combining speculative acceptance rate (k=6) with content-addressed DAG signature invariance.
agents.systems_architect: Splits workload across FAU Research Computing GPU cluster (heavy distillation) and ~$130 Homelab Mini PC + 10TB drive (continuous GraphRAG indexing).
agents.skeptic_reviewer: Demands >= 2.2x throughput speedup over unspeculative baseline, p_value < 0.01, and zero state-rollback leaks.

payload.proposed_title: Autonomous Graph-Loop Synthesis: Speculative GraphRAG Distillation & Sub-4-Bit Edge Verification
payload.hypothesis: Coupling FAU Research Computing GPU distillation with Homelab GraphRAG indexing and lookahead k=6 speculative edge verification achieves >2.5x speedup and 0% syntax drift.

payload.edge_validation_role: Local Apple Silicon / Rust crate invariant check

payload.title: Autonomous Graph-Loop Synthesis: Speculative GraphRAG Distillation & Sub-4-Bit Edge Verification
